title: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct BF16 on vLLM: one 128GB Spark
slug_note: Audio in and out (Thinker-Talker) at 70.5GB BF16 — the 128GB unified box is the smallest verified lane.

variation.quant_detail: BF16 reference; no official FP8 export was verifiable at the time of writing
variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-26 test

engine.config: Stock vLLM serve of the Thinker-Talker stack; streaming text and speech output, capped context

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-26): 114.5 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need). That is vLLM's 0.9 reservation of the shared pool, not the model's minimum need. Earlier estimate: 70.5GB weights + audio/vision encoders + KV on 128GB unified; does not fit 24GB or 72GB GPU lanes.

steps.text: Send audio/image/video inputs; responses stream as text and speech

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (625-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need

caveats: The card does not state a context length, so long_context is left null and the serve command caps at 32K.
Card metadata lists license 'other' with license_name Apache-2.0; check the repo LICENSE before redistribution.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-26), in vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 with the HF cache mounted: server ready 571 s after `docker run` (weights from local disk, kernel autotune included); the functional check passed. 114.5 GiB dropped from MemAvailable is vLLM's default 0.9 reservation of the 128 GB pool, not the model's minimum need.
